Correlation between body appreciation an.evidence_source: For female participants: 'Body mass index revealed to be significantly and negatively correlated to body appreciation, with a correlation of moderate magnitude.' The text describes a negative correlation of moderate magnitude. Based on standard effect size conventions, a moderate negative correlation is approximately -0.3 to -0.5. Since no exact value is provided, this is an estimate based on the qualitative description. Gender-specific: Female participants show this negative correlation; male participants' correlation between BMI and body appreciation is not explicitly stated in this section.

section_summary.extract_value: This section presents intercorrelation results for male and female participants separately. For males, body appreciation showed strong negative association with external shame and strong positive association with self-compassion. For females, body mass index was negatively and moderately correlated with body appreciation, and body appreciation showed strong negative association with external shame and strong positive association with self-compassion.
